text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: Creek, you don't look so good...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't mean to make you worry.<n>I'm fine. It's
nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I just feel like I've been getting tired<n>more easily
lately...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not your fault though! I've<n>probably just
been pushing myself a<n>tad too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although Super Creek is smiling,<n>something is very
clearly wrong. I<n>should make some adjustments to
her race schedule.
